info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Client Call Settings API
Get an Organization's MS Teams Settings

params.name: orgId
params.description: Retrieve MS Teams settings for the organization.

items.docs:
Not supported for Webex for Government (FedRAMP)
Get organization MS Teams settings. At an organization level, MS Teams settings allow access to viewing the `HIDE WEBEX APP` and `PRESENCE SYNC` settings. To retrieve an organization's MS Teams settings requires a full or read-only administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_read`.

info.name: Update an Organization's MS Teams Setting

params.name: orgId
params.description: Update MS Teams setting value for the organization.

items.docs:
Not supported for Webex for Government (FedRAMP)
Update an MS Teams setting. MS Teams setting can be updated at the organization level. Requires a full administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_write`.
